title: Perch seams (tests, fakes, deps): harness split, fake stubs, portable-pty + alacritty in the lock, GPL test
what:
(1) Move the tests/http.rs harness (Perch, Request, Answer and helpers, about lines 30-636) unchanged into tests/common/mod.rs, with `mod common;` in http.rs. Perch::builder() takes extra args, env and port (0 by default).
(2) Stub test files, each with one 404/401 pin that its owning slice replaces: tests/{runs,aoide,mesh,meta,install,agent,term,term_stream,term_agent,notes,mail,mail_agent,allow,watch,guard}.rs.
(3) fake_eidolon.rs (all stubs):
- `workflow` -> #[path] fake_eidolon/workflow.rs
- `tools|plugins|policy-rows` -> fake_eidolon/meta.rs
- the FAKE_ASKS hook -> fake_eidolon/asks.rs
- the FAKE_AGENT_CALL hook -> fake_eidolon/agent.rs
Also fix `log --json --after N` to print only id > N.
(4) Cargo.toml:
- [[bin]] fake_aoide and fake_minerva (required-features test-bins) as stubs
- portable-pty = "=0.9.0" and alacritty_terminal = { version = "=0.26.0", default-features = false }
- Cargo.lock updated in this slice, because releases build with --locked (installer/build.sh:51)
(5) tests/deps_smoke.rs: spawn /bin/sh through portable-pty, feed its bytes to an alacritty Term, read back plain text (the scout's probe as a test).
(6) tests/gpl_boundary.rs: parse Cargo.lock and fail on any package named aoide*.
(7) tests/live/fake-perch.sh + README:
- PORT is required, with no default.
- Temp MINERVA_HOME, HOME and XDG_CONFIG/DATA/STATE/CACHE/RUNTIME; --ui-dir webui/term; fake doors.
- Mints a code with the 0600 bearer file (curl -H @file) and prints the URL. This is a test perch only.
(8) perch/THIRD-PARTY.md and perch/LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt (alacritty_terminal is Apache-2.0 only).
tests:
`cargo test --features test-bins` in WSL (target /tmp/minerva-slices-target):
- The test-name list equals the old list plus the stubs.
- fake_log_json_after_filters_by_id fails if the fake fix is reverted.
- deps_smoke passes.
- gpl_boundary fails on a fixture lock that contains `aoide-core`.
- `cargo build --release --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl` succeeds, and `file` reports static-pie.
live_check: tests/live/fake-perch.sh with PORT=48102. The orchestrator opens the URL in the browser pane: the page boots in perch mode and the console is clean.
risk: Moving the harness can break CARGO_BIN_EXE_* or tempdir lifetimes, so diff the test names before and after. About 20 Windows-only entries also land in the lock, which is harmless.
